# AGENTS.md: rules for an AI building views with proposal-kit A proposal is something a homeowner signs. Every rule below stops a mistake that looks finished on screen and is wrong on paper. Read `components.json` for every prop. ## Use only these - `Money` for every amount: `` shows $24,900. Pass **whole cents**, never dollars. - `PaymentLine` for every monthly payment: ``. `apr` and `termMonths` are required. The APR and term print on the same line as the payment. - `SavingsEstimate` for every savings figure: ``. It computes the figure, says "Estimated" and prints the assumptions. Do not pass your own savings number. - shadcn/ui `Card`, `Badge`, `Button`, `Separator` from `@/components/ui/*` for layout and status. ## Never 1. Type a currency string (`"$24,900"`, `` `$${price}` ``, `

${price}

`) or format currency yourself (`Intl.NumberFormat` or `toLocaleString` with `style: "currency"`). Use `Money`. 2. Show a monthly payment ("/mo", "per month") without `PaymentLine`. 3. Use a hex, rgb or px value, an inline style size, an arbitrary value like `text-[#0d5c48]`, or a Tailwind palette class like `bg-green-500` (the palette is switched off, so it would render unstyled). Use the token classes: `bg-background`, `bg-card`, `bg-muted`, `text-foreground`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border`, `bg-primary text-primary-foreground`, `bg-success text-success-foreground`, `bg-estimate text-estimate-foreground`. Spacing, type and radius classes (`p-4`, `text-sm`, `rounded-lg`) are tokens too. 4. Show savings without `SavingsEstimate`, drop the word "Estimated", or hide the assumptions. 5. Show a status by color alone. Use `Ready to sign`. Use one `h1`, then `h2` per card. Keep text on token colors; they are all 4.5:1 or better in light and dark. Do not mention tax credits, rebates or incentive amounts. ## Data Keep amounts as whole cents in one data object at the top of the file. Derive totals from it (line items add up to the price; price minus down payment is the amount financed), so every number on the page comes from the same source. ## Check `npm run check` runs TypeScript (required props), ESLint with the `proposal-kit/*` rules, the token check and the tests. A view is done when it passes.

# proposal-kit

> A tiny design system for one solar proposal summary, built so an AI coding tool can't make the costly mistakes quietly. Three components carry every amount a homeowner signs: Money, PaymentLine and SavingsEstimate. Made-up data; unofficial sample.

## Read first

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the rules for building a view (use these three components, tokens only, never type a currency string)
- [components.json](components.json): every component with its purpose, props (types, which are required), do and don't, and one example

## Components

- [Money](src/components/Money.tsx): cents in, formatted currency out
- [PaymentLine](src/components/PaymentLine.tsx): monthly payment; apr and termMonths are required
- [SavingsEstimate](src/components/SavingsEstimate.tsx): requires assumptions, always says Estimated
- [shadcn/ui primitives](src/components/ui/): Card, Badge, Button, Separator

## Tokens and checks

- [Tokens](src/styles/tokens.css): color, type, spacing and radius, light and dark
- [Lint rules](eslint-rules/index.js): no-raw-currency, payment-needs-terms, tokens-only, savings-needs-estimate, no-color-only-status
- [Reference view](src/views/ProposalSummary.tsx): a proposal summary built only from the kit

## Optional

- [Storybook](https://gauravbasantani.github.io/proposal-kit/): every state of each component, with a "For AI tools" block
- [Eval](evals/README.md): fresh Claude Code runs with and without these docs, and what the checks caught

The proposal page is at `src/views/GeneratedSummary.tsx`. I couldn't run `npm run check`, so it hasn't been type-checked, linted or tested yet. Please run it before using the page.

**What's on the page:**
- **Header:** the page title is "Solar proposal for Maria Okafor", with the address, Brightline Home Solar, the November 12, 2026 date, and a "Ready to sign" badge (it has words and an icon, not just color).
- **Your system:** 7.38 kW (worked out from 18 × 410 W), one microinverter per panel, and an estimated 11,900 kWh a year.
- **Price:** the three line items, a line above the $22,000 total, then the $2,000 down payment and $20,000 amount financed. Both totals are calculated from the line items, not typed in.
- **Financing:** the $149.00 monthly payment is shown through `PaymentLine` with its 6.49% APR and 240-month term. Below it are the total of payments ($35,760), the interest ($15,760), and the total cost including the down payment ($37,760).
- **Savings:** shown through `SavingsEstimate`, which calculates the figure from the kWh, rate, yearly increase and years. It shows about $65,080 over 25 years and $1,785 the first year, labelled "Estimated", with the assumptions printed underneath.
- **Sign button:** a "Review and sign" button that doesn't do anything yet, since there's no signing flow in the repo.

**Things to know:**
- I checked every number you gave me, and they all agree with each other.
- The page compares the $149.00 payment with one calculated from the amount financed, APR and term. If they differ by more than a cent, the page shows an error rather than a wrong payment.
- I added the interest and total-cost-with-loan figures. They're calculated from your numbers, but you didn't ask for them, so remove them if they shouldn't be on the page.
- The savings figure assumes production stays at 11,900 kWh every year. It doesn't account for panels producing a little less as they age, which is how your $65,080 was worked out too.
- Tax credits and rebates are left out, as the repo's rules require.
- I don't know the exact wording the repo's lint rules check for, so they may flag something when you run them.

As your institution requires, please check the figures and wording before this goes to the homeowner.
